meta: AI makes beautiful posters and invitations, but Vietnamese text inside the image often has wrong accents or warped letters.

muc.title: A nice poster with garbled text
muc.text: AI makes beautiful event posters, but Vietnamese text in the image often has wrong accent marks or warped letters.

muc.title: Let AI sketch a layout
muc.text: Tell AI the type of event, date, time, place and main color, and ask for a few layout ideas.

muc.title: Make a background, leave space for text
muc.text: When making the image, tell AI not to write any text and to leave an empty area, so you can add the words later.

muc.title: Type the text yourself
muc.text: Open a photo app on your phone, type the event name, date and address yourself, and check every accent mark before printing.

muc.title: A birthday card with your own text
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a birthday card background with no text, then type your own message on it with a photo app.

thu: Ask a chatbot for a birthday card background with no text, then type your own message on it with a photo app.
